title: Grateful Dead Live at School Gymnasium, S.U.N.Y. on 1970-10-31
lineage: SBD > RTR > PCM > D;Sony PCM-R300 > Audiophile 2496 > Cool Edit Pro2 > .WAV > .FLAC

ai_review.summary: Raw yet spirited soundboard captures a wild late‑show with standout China Cat Sunflower, Dark Hollow, Viola Lee Blues and a soaring Good Lovin’ jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its high energy and memorable moments – the marching shuffle behind China Cat Sunflower, a rare beautiful Dark Hollow, the final Viola Lee Blues, and an immaculate Good Lovin' jam that rolls into Next Time. Although the recording is a bit ragged and the tracks are split, the soundboard source delivers enough clarity to enjoy the band's raw tearing‑through of Workingman’s material. Overall the show is regarded as a gem despite some audience chaos.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 4–5 stars and highlighted exceptional musical moments; the recording is a soundboard with minor roughness but generally good fidelity, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Raw and ragged in places but clear enough; reviewers note track‑splitting issues that disrupt continuity, yet the soundboard captures the performance with acceptable clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early part of the show was subdued, but the late‑show burst into high energy with chaotic crowd moments; transitions like Good Lovin' into Next Time are highlighted as seamless and powerful.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for tearing through Workingman's material, delivering energetic guitar work, and playing an exhausting marathon of pedal steel and Dead sets.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum sections noted as integral to Good Lovin' and The Other One, providing essential momentum for the jams.
